_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.47.0 and beamlynx-ui to its tagged 0.64.0, a pair that has to move together: pine-lang joins where: conditions with `or` instead of a comma, which beamlynx-ui 0.64.0's canvas filters write, and beamlynx-ui brings the canvas results grid and ships its own fonts.
